title: Some neutron stars exhibit glitches—sudden spin-ups.
narration: Some neutron stars exhibit glitches—sudden spin-ups. Astronomers call these events glitches. These sudden spin-ups are one of the most intriguing behaviors in the cosmos. In this scene, we'll introduce you to this phenomenon, setting the stage for a deeper dive into what causes them and what they reveal about the nature of dense matter.
